summary: MySims entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: MySims
entries.definitive_edition: MySims: Cozy Bundle on PC, with original Wii/DS and old PC route documented if needed

primary.why: The modern Cozy Bundle PC route is the best current capture path and packages MySims with MySims Kingdom as retro re-releases. The older 2008 PC version had PC-exclusive online/content features, while Wii and DS are distinct original-platform routes.
primary.how_to_play: Use MySims: Cozy Bundle on PC. Record storefront/build, graphics settings, Steam Deck state if relevant, save/town progress, whether MySims Kingdom is included in the same session, and whether Wii/DS/old PC-exclusive content was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original platform versions with distinct controls and DS adaptation
secondary.why: Cozy Bundle is the current route, but original Wii/DS identity is different.

secondary.what_to_play: Document only if preserving the original PC release.
secondary.why: The modern Cozy Bundle route supersedes it for current access.

all_releases.reason: primary: current easiest route and best capture path on PC.
